groups.title: 2 ports
groups.summary: A1 engineering review. Native electrical and routing checks pass; physical tests and supplier DFM remain open.

views.title: Controls & prototype
views.caption: Actual pad locations: termination shunts, AUX power enables, I/O and isolated prototype grids. All shunts open by default.

views.title: Lid artwork
views.caption: Shared vector artwork drives the 0.4 mm engraved roof, numbered male DE9 pinout and port identity.

views.title: Schematic
views.caption: Native KiCad schematic; connector pin mapping and protection.

views.title: CAN pairs
views.caption: Native path measurement: H amber, L cyan, bottom escapes dashed. No controlled impedance or bitrate claim.

views.title: Enclosure
views.caption: Six exploded screws and heat-set inserts; four broad corner mounting ears and filleted rear supports.

views.title: Cable clamp
views.caption: Native PCB model and hard-stop clamp. Two adhesive silicone pads required; pull testing pending.

views.title: Lid markings
views.caption: Recessed port names, complete CAN pinout, part revision and github.com/mvalancy.

views.title: Interactive 3D
views.caption: Shared cad-agent viewer of current A1 exported solids: orbit, part visibility, explode and section. Mating envelopes retain stated assumptions.

views.title: Corner mounts
views.caption: Four 26 mm-wide corner ears, R4 roots, 7 mm thickness and recessed M3 holes. Exported base oblique top view; physical strength remains untested.

views.title: Dimensions
views.caption: Parameter-driven enclosure dimensions and hardware; prototype fit remains unverified.

views.title: Pinout proof
views.caption: © NVIDIA, P4071 A02 sheet 11. Original J47 source excerpt; see Pinout proof for provenance and carrier limits.

views.title: Insert supports
views.caption: Section of the exported base below the clamp deck: actual boss-to-wall ribs and filleted roots. No load rating is established by this view.
